description: This file contains unit tests for the GstGenericPlayer component, including setup, teardown, and various configuration expectations using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreated
methods.description: Sets up expectations for creating and initializing the GStreamer pipeline, including factory creation, signal setup, and message callback registration.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Sets up expectations for tearing down the GStreamer pipeline, including shutting down tasks and unreferencing objects.

methods.name: expectShutdown
methods.description: Prepares expectations for shutting down the player, including creating a shutdown task and joining the worker thread.

methods.name: expectStop
methods.description: Prepares expectations for stopping the player, including creating a stop task.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Mocks task enqueueing by executing the task immediately when enqueued.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Invokes the source-setup callback with provided GstElement.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Invokes the element-setup callback with provided GstElement.

methods.name: triggerDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Invokes the deep-element-added callback with provided GstElement.

methods.name: setPipelineState
methods.description: Sets the state of the pipeline to the specified GstState.

methods.name: initFactories
methods.description: Initializes factory mocks, specifically the GstSrc factory mock.

methods.name: expectMakePlaybin
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the 'playbin' element.

methods.name: expectSetFlags
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring play flags, including native video and audio flags.

methods.name: expectSetFlagsWithNativeAudio
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring play flags with native audio support.

methods.name: expectSetSignalCallbacks
methods.description: Sets expectations for connecting GObject signals for source setup, element setup, and deep element added.

methods.name: expectSetUri
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the URI property on the pipeline.

methods.name: expectCheckPlaySink
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving and configuring the 'playsink' element.

methods.name: expectSetMessageCallback
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating the GStreamer dispatcher thread.
